card.name: Words just before a quantity or limit
card.fires_on: Small words and spaces just before a number or amount, such as 'no more than', 'up to', 'first' and 'for', mostly in alcohol and risk-statistics text. Also on words about statistical differences.

modes.label: Before an amount
modes.description: A linking word or space right before a number of drinks, months or years.

modes.label: Limit wording
modes.description: The word than or to in a 'no more than' or 'up to' limit.
modes.example: have no more<< than>> a small drink once or twice a week

modes.label: Statistical difference
modes.description: Words about detecting or judging differences or significance in study results.
modes.example: capable of<< detecting>> a very large difference between treatments

card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number or limit, like drinks per day or months, or a statement about study differences.
